title: How do I install Office 365 on my PC?
description: Ready to get started with Office on your PC? We'll show you how.   For more help, visit https://support.office.com/

asr.full_text: Hey, this is Ryan from Office,. And today I'm going to walk you through how to install Office 365 on your PC. To get started, go to setup.office.com and sign in with your Microsoft account. If you don't have an account,. Watch my video on creating one. The link is below. Enter your product key and follow the prompts. Now, to install Office 365, go to office.com forward slash my account and sign in. Click install and then follow the prompts. When Office is finished installing, you're all set. From your account page, you can manage your Office installations and share your subscription. As you may know, Office 365 has two plans, so you can choose the one that's right for. You. Have other questions about Microsoft Office? Check out the other Office Help videos. We're here to help you.

The sampled screens show Office account and installation options consistent with that instructional purpose, with no separate investment, payment, credential-harvesting, or deceptive-benefit offer described. It points to a support site, although the safety of any external destination is not established.
